en: Multi-view color postcard with four photographs of city landmarks separated by red borders. The upper-left image shows a central square with parked cars and a large domed former mosque with a tall column monument in front. The upper-right image depicts a neoclassical building facade with arched windows and a sign above the entrance. In the center is a small city coat of arms and the word 'PÉCS' on a blue strip. The lower-left image shows a church-like building with a tower and cross in a quiet street. The lower-right image presents a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers partly obscured by trees and a stone retaining wall in the foreground. The reverse side is blank with standard postcard layout lines for address and stamp.
